records_matrix.claim: AI provider adapter, model call, and response parser are absent in current Resident.
Backend retention, deletion, backup, restore, and regional/data-residency behavior are unverified.
Credential creation, secret storage, rotation, revocation, compromise response, and least privilege are not implemented.
AI response schema validation and semantic grounding are not implemented.
No environment separation exists for development, test, benchmark, and production backend data/secrets.

predicate_detail.reason: claim requires external or live state

records_matrix.claim: Generated or candidate code has no implemented sandbox, resource cap, or network egress restriction.
No encryption-at-rest or backup-secret handling proof exists for private exported packets or backend records.
No incident-response plan exists for credential leak, data exposure, malicious candidate, bad promotion, benchmark leak, or corrupted evidence.
The project has not decided whether any deployed endpoint/app is public, private-by-obscurity, authenticated, or local-only.
No user-data deletion/export completeness proof covers all local, backend, Notes, logs, receipts, and caches.
No safe degradation plan defines what remains usable when AI, backend, GitHub, Shortcuts, Notes, or network are unavailable simultaneously.
The deployed public runtime was not executed in the completed audit.
Offline behavior depends on static fetches, CDN JSZip, backend, and Shortcuts, which can fail.
PWA/service-worker/cache invalidation lifecycle is not explicitly governed or proven.
No disaster-recovery procedure covers loss of device, browser data, GitHub access, backend, and Notes together.
No deployment canary/staged rollout or post-deploy rollback drill is authorized.
